title: Pirates Almost Never Made Anyone Walk the Plank #Shorts
description:
Pirates almost never made anyone walk the plank. Historians can prove only a handful of cases, and most are from long after the famous pirates were gone. The plank became famous thanks to storybooks, and then Treasure Island and Peter Pan.
